title: Layer Exchange
tagline: LP token management across exchanges should be easy. This current version is working towards providing liquidity to Uniswap v3. We are also developing a stablecoin component.
description: We have utilised Uniswap (v3) to select optimal price ranges for LP tokens on behalf of a user. In a separate component, single assets are paired with a synthetic stablecoin and deposited in Uniswap pools. We are currently working on combining these components to manage LP tokens appropriately to collateralise the stablecoin.
